API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS)NSS Resource Get NSS Servers
NSS Resource Get NSS Servers
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/nssServers

Retrieves a list of registered NSS servers. .

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
type
string

Possible values: [NONE, SOFTWARE_AA_FLAG, NSS_FOR_WEB, NSS_FOR_FIREWALL, VZEN, VZEN_SME, VZEN_SMLB, PINNED_NSS, MD5_CAPABLE, ADP, ZIRSVR, NSS_FOR_ZPA]

The server type

Responses
​
200
401
500

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

System-generated identifier of the NSS server based on the software platform

name
string

NSS server name

status
string

Enables or disables the status of the NSS server

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED, DISABLED_BY_SERVICE_PROVIDER, NOT_PROVISIONED_IN_SERVICE_PROVIDER, IN_TRIAL]

state
string

The health of the NSS server

Possible values: [UNHEALTHY, HEALTHY, UNKNOWN]

icapSvrId
int32

The ICAP server ID

]
